title: Flagship Phone Reveal
source: 2026 flagship smartphone launch film: back from the moon, rebuilt part by part
description: A narrated product reveal: a moon-photo hook, a dip to black, then chip, battery and camera proofs in dark macros, white-lab flat-lays and big outdoor shots, closing on a still hero with beat-cut finish swaps and the name on black.
prompt30: Make a 30 s launch film for our new flagship phone in the phone-reveal style: open on a stunning photo from last year's model, then show the chip, battery and camera with one calm narrator, and end on the name.
